game_concept: A strategy race set in Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood, the glowing ancient tree: the forest ranger must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood: the glowing ancient tree
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Keywords and identifiers: build a valid C source file that prints 11. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the splitter at (3, 3), with the upper processing path on row 0 and lower path on row 5. Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Merge the two plate streams at (8, 3), then use the shared assembler and output. Deliver exactly 7 components (4 upper, 3 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 7.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Loop Picker' (Week 5 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Glowing Heartwood'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the spirit shrine by solving code steps involving picks_right that move the forest ranger forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the spirit shrine first, or lives reach 0.
